description:
Is the agent ALIVE right now? Verdict ALIVE / DEGRADED / DOWN / UNKNOWN before your agent wastes timeouts calling a dead service. Call it before calling an unknown agent's endpoint — the verdict is backed by ~270 real probes per agent per 30 days (15-minute probe cycle), not a one-shot ping like generic URL checkers. Returns action CALL / SLOW / AVOID, uptime percent, p50/p95 latency, flaps and last-probe age. By ERC-8004 agent_id or Solana asset. REST: GET /api/v1/agent-liveness ($0.01).

Args:
    agent_id: ERC-8004 agent id (or use solana_asset)
    solana_asset: Solana 8004 agent pubkey (alternative)
    window_days: SLA window 1-30 (default 7)
name: agent_liveness
title: Agent endpoint liveness
